finePrint.summary: A new subscription can be refunded in full if requested within the first 7 days.

quote.text: If you're not completely satisfied with BetterClaw within the first 7 days of your subscription, we'll issue a full refund - no questions asked, no hoops to jump through.

finePrint.summary: Refund requests must be submitted within 7 calendar days of the initial payment date.

quote.text: Your refund request must be submitted within 7 calendar days of your initial payment date.

finePrint.summary: Outside the 7-day guarantee, no refunds are offered once services are provisioned.

quote.text: Outside that guarantee, due to the digital nature of our services, we do not offer refunds once the agent infrastructure services have been provisioned, except where our Data Processing Addendum provides for one.

finePrint.summary: Platform usage is metered in credits where one credit equals one minute of agent runtime.

quote.text: One credit is one minute of your agent's machine running.

finePrint.summary: Using your own model key means model usage is billed by the provider and does not consume credits.

quote.text: Managed LLM usage is also converted into credits, but with your own key (BYOK) model usage is billed by your provider and never draws credits.

finePrint.summary: Each tier includes a fixed monthly credit allowance that limits how much agents can run.

quote.text: Basic includes 500 credits a month, Pro 12,000 and Business 40,000.

finePrint.summary: The entry Basic plan normally costs $19 per month for 1 agent and 500 credits.

quote.text: Basic is $19/month for 1 agent and 500 credits/month.

finePrint.summary: The Pro plan normally costs $49 per month for 5 agents and 12,000 credits.

quote.text: Pro is $49/month for 5 agents and 12,000 credits/month.

finePrint.summary: The Business plan normally costs $149 per month for 25 agents and 40,000 credits.

quote.text: Business is $149/month for 25 agents and 40,000 credits/month.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can modify, suspend or discontinue the service at any time without notice or liability.

quote.text: We reserve the right to modify, suspend, or discontinue the service at any time without notice or liability.

finePrint.summary: The published pricing structure may be changed by the vendor from time to time.

quote.text: Our pricing structure is detailed on our Platform and may change from time to time.

finePrint.summary: After a refund, configurations and data are kept for 30 days before deletion.

quote.text: Your agent configurations and data will be retained for 30 days in case you decide to resubscribe.

finePrint.summary: On Basic, running out of credits pauses the agent until the next monthly reset.

quote.text: On Basic your agent pauses until credits reset next month - that is the whole consequence, and nothing is charged beyond your $19.

finePrint.summary: Support typically responds within 24 hours on business days.

quote.text: We typically respond within 24 hours on business days.

finePrint.summary: Issues outside the guarantee are handled by support on a case-by-case basis with no promised remedy.

quote.text: If there is an issue with your purchase or the quality of the service, please contact our support team, and we will address your concerns on a case-by-case basis.

trials.claim: Growing workflow library with new workflows added every week
trials.claimQuote: Pick from a growing library for sales, support, finance, and ops, with new workflows added every week
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about a growing workflow library or weekly additions.

trials.claim: Zero platform markup on LLM inference
trials.claimQuote: Pay zero platform markup on LLM inference, keeping your AI costs predictable and your provider relationship yours
trials.reasoning: The vendor states every plan is BYOK, users pay their model provider directly at their price, and it charges for the platform not a margin on tokens; the managed-credit note does not show a markup on BYOK inference.

exhibits.quote: One credit is one minute of your agent's machine running. Managed LLM usage is also converted into credits, but with your own key (BYOK) model usage is billed by your provider and never draws credits.
exhibits.argument: Managed LLM usage costs platform credits, so zero markup applies only with BYOK and not to all inference.

exhibits.quote: my short chat messages just testing whether things were working were eating away at my small credit balance on Openrouter
exhibits.argument: Testing messages consumed paid credits, undermining predictable zero-markup costs.

exhibits.quote: Use any model - OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, or local via Ollama. You pay your provider directly, so no matter where model pricing goes, you stay in control of it.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users pay their provider directly for inference with no intermediary markup.

exhibits.quote: Every plan is BYOK. You pay your model provider directly at their price. We charge for the platform, not a margin on your tokens.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms every plan is BYOK and it takes no margin on tokens.

trials.claim: No-code AI agents with BYOK, 99+ connectors, trust levels and approval queues
trials.claimQuote: Build no-code AI agents with BYOK, 99+ one-click connectors, trust levels, and approval queues
trials.reasoning: The defense exhibit supports no-code agents, BYOK, and 120+ apps, but no exhibit shown verifies trust levels or approval queues, so the full claim cannot be confirmed.

exhibits.quote: On Basic, yes - BYOK only. Pro and Business support both BYOK and managed keys, so you can let BetterClaw handle model access instead of wiring up your own provider account.
exhibits.argument: Basic requires BYOK only, so users must supply and pay for their own keys.

exhibits.quote: Following this recommendation would immediately consume our entire agent allowance just to organise our clients.
exhibits.argument: Agent allowance limits prevent scaling as implied by unlimited connectors and queues.

exhibits.quote: BetterClaw is a managed, no-code AI agent platform: build agents in minutes, use any of 28+ model providers with your own key at zero markup, and connect 120+ apps.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes a no-code platform with BYOK at zero markup and 120+ app connections.

trials.claim: Create agents visually with plain language, no YAML, Docker or config files
trials.claimQuote: Create agents visually with templates—describe the job in plain language, no YAML, no Docker, no config files
trials.reasoning: The vendor explicitly says agents are built through a visual interface with no YAML, config file, or terminal step, and a buyer confirms no YAML or installation in use.

exhibits.quote: Secrets must be declared in the skill’s Credentials, or the scripts won’t receive them.
exhibits.argument: Users must configure credentials and scripts, contradicting no config files claim.

exhibits.quote: I spent nearly 100 credits trying to make sure that everything was going through the LLM that I wanted through chat
exhibits.argument: Setup required extensive troubleshooting rather than plain-language visual creation.

exhibits.quote: No. Agents are built through a visual interface. There is no YAML, no config file, and no terminal step.
exhibits.argument: Vendor explicitly states agents are built visually with no YAML or config file.

exhibits.quote: No VPS to babysit, no YAML to wrestle with, and nothing to install.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms live use required no YAML, no VPS and nothing to install.

trials.claim: Bring your own API keys and seller never touches tokens
trials.claimQuote: Connect your own API keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, or Ollama—BetterClaw never touches your tokens
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show credentials are stored encrypted by the platform and loaded into the agent for tasks before being purged, so the seller does handle keys despite the 'never touches' wording.

exhibits.quote: They load into the agent only for the task that needs them and are purged from memory after 5 minutes, and agents never see the raw credentials.
exhibits.argument: Keys are stored, loaded and held for 5 minutes, so the seller does handle tokens.

exhibits.quote: All credentials are encrypted with AES-256. Agents can only access resources you explicitly allow through workspace scoping.
exhibits.argument: Credentials are stored encrypted by the platform, contradicting never touches tokens.

exhibits.quote: Use any model - OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, or local via Ollama. You pay your provider directly, so no matter where model pricing goes, you stay in control of it.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms users connect their own keys from listed providers and pay providers directly.

exhibits.quote: They load into the agent only for the task that needs them and are purged from memory after 5 minutes, and agents never see the raw credentials.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states agents never see raw credentials and keys are purged after use.

trials.claim: AI agent saves hours every week once built
trials.claimQuote: Adding an AI agent to your workflow should save you hours every week—once you figure out how to build it.
trials.reasoning: The defense reviews speak only of potential time savings and a faster one-time setup, while other reviews report crashes and errors, so neither side proves hours saved every week.

exhibits.quote: when agents crash mid-response, we lose our workflow and our trust in the tool.
exhibits.argument: Crashes cause lost workflow, contradicting saving hours every week.

exhibits.quote: I can't even use the tool at all anymore. It only gives me errors.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports total failure with only errors, showing no time saved.

exhibits.quote: I like the idea behind the software and its potential to help users save time, reduce repetitive tasks, and work more efficiently.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool helps save time and reduce repetitive tasks.

exhibits.quote: It took me maybe an hour to set it up while with other tools (ottokit, pabbly, ...) I spend days and was not able to even fill the database with the initial data because of various constraints/errors..
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports completing in an hour work that took days with other tools.

I was able to get agents up and running without worrying about the infrastructure
The reply quality itself is already working well
Betterclaw can help create short video by few click only.
BetterClaw has been useful for things like going through emails and highlighting the ones that actually need my attention
My research agent performed well
